title: Edgeware | Funding - Asset Diversification proposal_Fund B
body:
_**11th November 2022**_
_**Advait, VismayJoshi, Ash**_
_**Discord: Advait#5627, Vismay Joshi#6445, ash|inthewild#2521**_

Note: This idea was briefly discussed in the ending parts of the community call on 22/9/11


**PURPOSE**:

The purpose of this proposal is to raise a second fund of capital for the financial working group consisting of Advait, Vismay and Ash. Our request is to raise $20,000 in EDG (market equivalent) for investment purposes on behalf of Edgeware’s community Treasury into other blockchain assets (tokens). This second fund has the same goal as the previous fund and will be used to create a diversified portfolio of blockchain assets (tokens) that appreciates in value (monetary, utility) overtime that Edgeware can use for capital heavy opex (operating expense) or funding future growth.
- Requesting: $20,000 in EDG equivalent (as per 7 day average)
- Team members: Advait, Vismay, Ash
- Expected return on investment: 15-20 % 
- Fees: 0-20 
- 0%- fees for management (We are waiving this for this fund) 
- 20% - profit allocation to be paid as productivity bounty
- Timeline: 11-9-22 to 11-9-23



**RESULTS:**

The group thus far has been allocated $11,000 on 03/23/22, currently as of 11/9/22 we have roughly $ 6866 BUSD and the remaining $ 1512(altcoins - consisting of ETH, DOT, ATOM assets). We have seen a loss of -23.28% on the allocated assets. 

During this period of time, the overall market cap of the space has fallen from ≈ $1,900,000,000 (Feb-15-22), to $805,000,000 (Nov-9-22) a drawdown of nearly $1,000,000,00 the fund with L1 assets seeing a price reduction of:
